basis: Native comparison of the sealed expected asset for csharp-B01 and csharp-B02. For every EXPECTED alternative and each of its witnesses (copied unchanged from the sealed asset) the tree-sitter-c-sharp tree of the witness's source, parsed by the registered native build (provenance in native; raw_native pins the local raw observation), is searched for a node of one of the alternative's sealed types with the witness's span (match span) or start (match starts-at): MATCH, else MISMATCH, or NOT_APPLICABLE when the native parse did not complete. An alternative is MISMATCH if any witness is, MATCH if some witness is and none mismatches, NOT_APPLICABLE otherwise, and EXECUTED when a completed native witness was compared. Each mismatch has a disposition with a cause: GRAMMAR_DEFECT, KIND_MAP_ERROR, EXPECTED_ERROR or DESIGN_DIFFERENCE. Expectations, the kind map and the observation are not changed by this asset; a sealed value that the native result contradicts stays as sealed and is reported. The comparison covers the witnesses only: it does not say the grammar parses every construct of an alternative, and a MATCH is a property of the pinned Roslyn observation's spans on these sources. Revision r2 compares the r2 expected asset and kind map, which correct values after the r1 native result was seen (after_native corrections: four from the native comparison itself and eleven from the audit of the differential-oracle alternatives, #233 G1AUDIT76); the r1 executed asset stays as sealed. The counts sealed_match, corrected and corrected_match keep the uncorrected comparisons and the post-native corrections apart.
